items.title: TryNGo: Belajar dan Jalankan 28 Bahasa Pemrograman di Browser
items.excerpt: Coba TryNGo langsung di tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id: belajar 28 trek coding dwibahasa, editor ala VS Code, runtime WebAssembly di browser, kuis instan, gratis tanpa login.
items.body:
Niat belajar stack baru sering berhenti di tengah jalan karena laptop harus dipenuhi installer Go, Python, PHP, Docker, hingga konfigurasi editor sebelum menyentuh satu baris logika program. Di aplikasi produksi **[TryNGo](https://tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id)** ([tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id](https://tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id)), hambatan setup itu hilang sepenuhnya: buka peramban di Windows, macOS, Linux, maupun ponsel, pilih materi, lalu jalankan kode sungguhan saat itu juga tanpa membuat akun.

![Halaman utama TryNGo menampilkan pilihan jalur belajar teknologi interaktif](/news/assets/tryngo-platform-homepage-36ff30f7.webp)

Dirancang sebagai ruang praktik terpadu dengan React 19, TypeScript, dan Tailwind CSS v4 serta di-host ringan di Cloudflare Pages, seluruh alur belajar TryNGo berjalan 100% di sisi pengguna tanpa antrean server eksekusi maupun biaya langganan.

## 28 Jalur Karier Terstruktur dari Nol hingga Siap Pakai

Alih-alih menjejalkan potongan artikel acak, TryNGo menyusun kurikulum mingguan yang jelas tingkatannya untuk pemula, menengah, hingga topik produksi dalam dua bahasa sekaligus (Indonesia dan Inggris).

Total ada 28 trek teknologi populer yang bisa langsung Anda jelajahi. Jalur web dan antarmuka mencakup 10 teknologi mulai dari HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Vue, Next.js, Angular, hingga Svelte. Untuk pengembangan backend tersedia 12 trek yakni Go, Python, Django, Node.js, NestJS, PHP, Laravel, CodeIgniter 4, C#, Ruby on Rails, Spring Boot, dan Rust. Kebutuhan data serta infrastruktur dilengkapi 5 trek basis data (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, GraphQL) ditambah satu trek khusus Docker.

Butuh mencari materi tertentu dengan cepat saat bekerja? Tekan pintasan `Ctrl + K` (atau `Cmd + K` di Mac) untuk membuka pencarian instan yang tetap menemukan topik meski pengetikan sedikit meleset.

## Ngoding Langsung di Layar Split-Screen dengan WebAssembly Asli

Nilai jual utama [tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id](https://tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id) terasa begitu Anda masuk ke halaman pelajaran. Layar terbagi dua antara modul bacaan dan **Monaco Editor**, mesin editor yang sama dengan Visual Studio Code lengkap dengan pewarnaan sintaks, nomor baris, serta pemisah panel yang bebas digeser ukurannya.

Setiap kali Anda membuka bab baru, cuplikan kode pelajaran langsung terisi otomatis ke dalam editor agar siap dimodifikasi dan dijalankan dengan satu klik. Di balik tombol jalankan, kode Go (Yaegi dan TinyGo), Python (Pyodide), PHP, Ruby, maupun kueri SQL dieksekusi langsung di memori peramban memakai runtime **WebAssembly** asli, sementara latihan React, Vue 3, Svelte 5, HTML, dan CSS dikompilasi seketika di browser. Untuk latihan infrastruktur tanpa menyalakan layanan lokal, tersedia juga simulator interaktif untuk perintah Docker, shell Redis, dokumen MongoDB, dan kueri GraphQL.

Selesai membaca dan mengutak-atik kode, uji pemahaman lewat kuis pilihan ganda yang langsung menampilkan nilai serta pembahasannya. Semua centang materi selesai dan riwayat skor tersimpan aman di `localStorage` browser Anda sendiri dengan pilihan tema terang maupun gelap.

## Cara Mulai: Buka Web Langsung atau Pasang Lokal di Semua OS

Bagi pembelajar, mahasiswa, maupun engineer yang ingin langsung mencoba, Anda tidak perlu mengunduh atau menginstal apa pun. Cukup kunjungi **[https://tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id](https://tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id)** lewat Chrome, Safari, Edge, atau Firefox di Windows, macOS, Linux, hingga perangkat seluler.

Jika ingin menjalankan salinan lokal untuk kontribusi atau penggunaan offline dari [repositori resmi TryNGo](https://github.com/widifirmaan/reactjs-tryngo-programming-learning), siapkan Node.js `20.x` atau `22.x` (berjalan sama persis di PowerShell Windows, Terminal macOS, maupun terminal Linux) tanpa perlu database atau file environment khusus:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/widifirmaan/reactjs-tryngo-programming-learning.git
cd reactjs-tryngo-programming-learning/apps/web
npm install
npm run dev
```

Empat perintah resmi di atas mengunduh repositori, memasang paket proyek, dan langsung menyalakan server lokal di `http://localhost:3000`, sementara untuk penggunaan harian Anda cukup membuka langsung [tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id](https://tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id) dari browser apa saja.

en.title: TryNGo: Learn and Run 28 Tech Stacks Straight in Your Browser
en.excerpt: Try TryNGo live at tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id: 28 structured bilingual coding tracks, VS Code Monaco editor, in-browser WebAssembly execution, quizzes, zero login.
en.body:
Picking up a new programming stack often stalls before line one, buried under local compiler installs, mismatched runtimes, and editor configuration. With **[TryNGo](https://tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id)** live in production at [tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id](https://tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id), all of that setup disappears: open any modern browser on Windows, macOS, Linux, or mobile, pick a track, and execute real code right away without signing up.

![TryNGo platform homepage showcasing interactive coding learning paths](/news/assets/tryngo-platform-homepage-36ff30f7.webp)

Built cleanly on React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4 on Cloudflare Pages, the platform delivers interactive study guides and code sandboxes completely client-side, with no paywall or remote runner queues.

## 28 Structured Tracks Built for Practical Progression

Rather than scattering disconnected snippets, TryNGo maps complete weekly roadmaps from beginner basics through production topics in both English and Indonesian.

Twenty-eight dedicated curricula cover modern software engineering workflows end to end: ten frontend tracks spanning HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Vue, Next.js, Angular, and Svelte; twelve backend paths covering Go, Python, Django, Node.js, NestJS, PHP, Laravel, CodeIgniter 4, C#, Ruby on Rails, Spring Boot, and Rust; five data tracks for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, and GraphQL; plus a dedicated Docker track.

Whenever you want to jump straight to a concept, press `Ctrl + K` (or `Cmd + K` on Mac) for instant fuzzy search across every lesson module.

## Split-Screen Monaco Editor Powered by In-Browser WebAssembly

The moment you open a lesson on [tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id](https://tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id), structured Markdown explanations sit beside an embedded **Monaco Editor**, the core editor powering Visual Studio Code, complete with syntax highlighting, line numbers, code folding, and a draggable split-screen divider on desktop displays.

Opening any topic automatically loads its primary snippet straight into the workspace so you can tweak examples and hit run in a single click. Go (Yaegi and TinyGo), Python (Pyodide), PHP, Ruby, and SQL queries run directly inside browser memory via **WebAssembly** engines, while React, Vue 3, Svelte 5, HTML, and CSS compile instantaneously on the client. To practice containers and data stores without starting local background services, TryNGo also ships interactive in-browser simulators for Docker commands, Redis key-value shells, MongoDB documents, and GraphQL queries.

Once you finish experimenting with the code, check your understanding through built-in multiple-choice quizzes offering immediate scoring, answer keys, and topic feedback. All completed modules, checkmarks, and quiz records persist locally inside browser storage with light and dark theme switching.

## Getting Started Online or Running Locally on Any OS

Learners do not need to install any tools or sign up locally to benefit right away: open **[https://tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id](https://tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id)** in Chrome, Edge, Safari, or Firefox across Windows, macOS, Linux, or mobile devices and try running Go, Python, React, or SQL examples inside seconds.

Developers who want a local copy for offline study or curriculum contributions from the [official TryNGo repository](https://github.com/widifirmaan/reactjs-tryngo-programming-learning) only need Node.js `20.x` or `22.x` across Windows PowerShell, macOS Terminal, or Linux bash, with zero database or environment setup required:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/widifirmaan/reactjs-tryngo-programming-learning.git
cd reactjs-tryngo-programming-learning/apps/web
npm install
npm run dev
```

These four official setup commands clone the repository, install packages, and start the live local development server at `http://localhost:3000`, while daily learners can jump straight to [tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id](https://tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id).

items.title: Fitur NFSU2Recomp: Need for Speed Underground 2 Native di Apple Silicon
items.excerpt: Mengulas fitur lengkap NFSU2Recomp di Mac Apple Silicon: engine Metal Original dan HD, opsi Picture, launcher SwiftUI, kontroler XtendedInput, hingga manajer mod.
items.body:
**NFSU2Recomp** (`TalhaMudo/NFSU2Recomp`) membawa *Need for Speed: Underground 2* versi PC ke Mac Apple Silicon sebagai aplikasi ARM64 native berbasis Metal. Tidak ada lapisan Wine, CrossOver, emulator, maupun JIT saat balapan berjalan: biner `SPEED2.EXE` 32-bit beserta shader Direct3D 9 diterjemahkan terlebih dahulu menjadi kode C dan Metal Shading Language, sehingga gim langsung mengeksekusi instruksi ARM64 begitu diluncurkan.

![Tangkapan layar gameplay balapan malam Need for Speed Underground 2 di Apple Silicon melalui NFSU2Recomp](/news/assets/nfsu2-underground-2-gameplay-9db807bd.webp)

Bagi pemain, pendekatan tersebut bukan sekadar membungkus ulang gim lama agar mau terbuka di macOS. Proyek ini menyematkan dua pilihan engine grafis, layar lebar modern tanpa distorsi HUD, manajer save karier, dukungan kontroler analog XtendedInput, hingga sistem mod terisolasi langsung di dalam antarmuka launcher SwiftUI.

## Performa Metal Native dan Audio Bebas Putus

Di balik layar, `tools/lifter/reloc2.py` dan `tools/lifter/lift.py` mengangkat `23.278` fungsi x86-32 dari `SPEED2.EXE` menjadi kode C native yang terhubung ke lapisan `runtime/` untuk Metal, CoreAudio, dan input macOS. Ketika gim membuat thunk x86 sementara di stack saat runtime, `runtime/genexec.c` mengeksekusinya secara langsung, sedangkan `runtime/d3dx_hle.c` menggantikan jalur efek D3DX9 secara high-level agar tidak menjadi leher botol CPU.

Hasilnya terasa jauh melampaui lapisan translasi runtime. Pada pengujian di MacBook M1 Pro pada resolusi `1280x960`, `NFSU2Recomp` menyentuh `119 fps` (terbatas refresh rate 120 Hz) dengan beban CPU sekitar `12,6 ms` per frame, sementara pada resolusi Retina penuh `3024x1964` `120 fps`, engine standar menarik daya sekitar `6,5 W` dengan suhu di bawah `70` derajat Celsius tanpa memutar kipas. Dua timer audio `10 ms` di CoreAudio juga dijadwalkan dengan prioritas khusus agar musik serta efek mesin tidak patah saat memuat balapan atau ketika pengguna berpindah Space melalui Mission Control. Selain itu, kebocoran memori pada sesi panjang dan seluruh video intro maupun cerita karier beserta latar adegan prabalapan telah bekerja utuh dengan suara.

## Engine Original vs HD, Widescreen, dan Opsi Picture

Melalui jendela utama aplikasi, pengguna bisa memilih mode **Original** untuk tampilan klasik PC atau beralih ke mode **HD** yang menambahkan anti-aliasing MSAA (`2x` mulai 1440 baris ke atas dan `4x` di bawahnya), *screen-space reflections* (SSR), serta pantulan *ray-traced* yang memanfaatkan daya sekitar `18 W` pada layar Retina penuh.

Pada tampilan layar lebar hingga 4K, proyeksi Hor+ dan koreksi `NFSRES` serta `HUDFIX` menjaga rasio antarmuka tetap proporsional sekaligus mencegah objek di sisi kiri dan kanan layar terlambat muncul. Filter gelap saat hujan juga sudah menutupi seluruh layar lebar, dan grafik tenaga maupun torsi di layar dyno tampil lengkap. Sejak rilis `v2.5`, engine HD memperoleh panel **Settings > Picture** untuk mengurangi *colour tint* versi PC, mengaktifkan gamma konsol, *edge smoothing*, *sharpening*, serta menyalakan pantulan langit, sorot lampu mobil, dan detail ekstra pada aspal basah maupun kaca spion. Pintasan `Cmd-F` berpindah antara mode jendela dan layar penuh, sementara `Cmd+Shift+D` menyimpan dump frame untuk diagnostik visual.

## Launcher SwiftUI, Manajemen Save, dan XtendedInput

Semua pengaturan dikemas ke launcher SwiftUI bawaan. Saat pertama kali dibuka, aplikasi meminta folder gim yang berisi `SPEED2.EXE` versi v1.2 tanpa CD check (mendukung edisi North American `4.800.512` byte maupun European `4.788.224` byte) tanpa menyertakan aset gim di dalam unduhan. Dari satu jendela yang sama, pemain dapat membuka menu **Saves** untuk membuat profil karier baru, mencadangkan save, hingga mengekspor atau mengimpor arsip ZIP, serta menekan **Make Copy** untuk membundel salinan aplikasi portabel lengkap dengan aset gim memanfaatkan kloning APFS.

Untuk kendali, `NFSU2Recomp` mendukung keyboard, mouse, serta kontroler Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, MFi, hingga perangkat DirectInput seperti gamepad 8BitDo. Khusus biner North American v1.2, menu **Controls** menyediakan opsi **XtendedInput layout** yang memetakan pelatuk `RT` dan `LT` sebagai gas dan rem analog terpisah serta menyesuaikan navigasi tombol di seluruh menu mengikuti berkas `scripts/NFSU_XtendedInput.ini`. Mode setir balap dan multiplayer jaringan saat ini masih belum tersedia.

## Manajer Mod Terisolasi dan Cara Pemasangan Resmi

Sejak rilis `v2.6`, launcher menyertakan tab **Settings > Mods** agar pemain bisa memasang arsip `.zip`, `.7z`, `.rar`, atau folder mod baik dalam format berkas langsung (seperti `TRACKS`, `GLOBAL`, dan `CARS`) maupun paket skrip Binary dan Binarius (`install.end` dan `.endlauncher`) lengkap dengan prompt interaktifnya. Tersedia juga baris khusus **NFSU2 Unlimiter 4.0.0.802** untuk edisi NA yang menjalankan logika plugin ASI secara statis agar mod mobil dan part tambahan dapat dimuat. Seluruh berkas ubahan disimpan di `~/Library/Application Support/NFSU2/Mods`, sehingga folder gim asli tidak pernah tersentuh dan dapat dikembalikan ke kondisi standar kapan saja lewat tombol **Restore Original Game**.

Karena proyek ini memang dirancang khusus sebagai port native Apple Silicon (macOS 11 ke atas di Mac M1 atau yang lebih baru, sedangkan Windows tetap memakai gim PC aslinya), pengguna cukup mengunduh arsip `NFSU2.zip` dari halaman Releases GitHub, memindahkan `NFSU2.app` ke folder `Applications`, lalu membersihkan flag karantina sebelum membuka launcher dan memilih folder `SPEED2.EXE` milik sendiri:

```bash
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/NFSU2.app
shasum -a 256 /path/to/SPEED2.EXE
```

Perintah `xattr` menghapus atribut karantina Gatekeeper agar `NFSU2.app` dapat dibuka, sementara `shasum -a 256` memverifikasi kecocokan hash biner `SPEED2.EXE` v1.2 North American atau European Anda sebelum ditautkan di jendela launcher.

en.title: NFSU2Recomp Features: Native Need for Speed Underground 2 on Mac
en.excerpt: Overview of NFSU2Recomp features on Apple Silicon: native Metal and HD engines, Picture options, SwiftUI launcher, XtendedInput controls, and mod isolation.
en.body:
**NFSU2Recomp** (`TalhaMudo/NFSU2Recomp`) brings PC *Need for Speed: Underground 2* to Apple Silicon Macs as a native ARM64 application powered by Metal. There is no Wine, CrossOver, emulator, or runtime JIT loop during gameplay: the 32-bit `SPEED2.EXE` machine code and Direct3D 9 shaders are statically translated ahead of time into C and Metal Shading Language so the game executes natively at launch.

![Night race gameplay screenshot of Need for Speed Underground 2 on Apple Silicon via NFSU2Recomp](/news/assets/nfsu2-underground-2-gameplay-9db807bd.webp)

Rather than merely booting an older PC binary on macOS, the project builds an integrated experience directly around the game, packing Original and HD engines, modern widescreen projection, a SwiftUI launcher with save backups, analog controller layouts, and isolated mod management.

## Native Metal Performance and Gap-Free Audio

Under the hood, `tools/lifter/reloc2.py` and `tools/lifter/lift.py` recover functions across `SPEED2.EXE` (lifting `23,278` x86-32 functions into native C) and connect them to hand-written `runtime/` layers for Metal, CoreAudio, and macOS input. Short x86 stack thunks generated dynamically at runtime run through `runtime/genexec.c`, while `runtime/d3dx_hle.c` implements the high-level D3DX9 effects path so effect setup does not bottleneck the CPU.

Developer benchmarks reflect how light native ARM64 execution runs. On a MacBook M1 Pro at `1280x960`, races hit `119 fps` (capped by the 120 Hz display) with around `12.6 ms` CPU frame time. Running at native `3024x1964` Retina `120 fps`, the standard engine draws about `6.5 W` combined CPU and GPU power under `70` degrees Celsius with the fans off. Two `10 ms` CoreAudio loops run on elevated priority timers so engine sound and soundtrack music stay clean during race loads or Mission Control Space switches. Long-session memory growth is fixed, while intro videos, story movies with audio, pre-race scenes, and dyno power/torque charts all render properly.

## Original vs HD Engine, Widescreen, and Picture Controls

From the main window, players can switch between **Original** mode for classic PC rendering and the **HD** engine, which turns on MSAA (`2x` at 1440 vertical lines and up, `4x` below), screen-space reflections (SSR), and ray-traced reflections drawing around `18 W` at full Retina resolution.

For modern wide and 4K displays, Hor+ projection together with `NFSRES` and `HUDFIX` keep UI proportions accurate and eliminate edge pop-in across wide viewports. Rain darkening effects now span the whole screen instead of a centered 4:3 strip. Starting in release `v2.5`, the HD engine adds a **Settings > Picture** tab to tame PC colour tint, apply console-style gamma, toggle edge smoothing and sharpening, and enable sky reflections, headlight illumination, and extra reflection detail in wet asphalt and the rear-view mirror. Pressing `Cmd-F` toggles windowed and fullscreen modes, while `Cmd+Shift+D` captures a diagnostic frame dump.

## SwiftUI Launcher, Save Manager, and XtendedInput

The built-in SwiftUI app wraps setup and day-to-day utilities cleanly. On first launch, it asks for your existing game folder containing v1.2 no-CD `SPEED2.EXE` (supporting North American `4,800,512`-byte and European `4,788,224`-byte executables) without bundling copyrighted game assets. Inside the **Saves** menu, players can create career profiles, keep backups, or export and import ZIP archives, while **Make Copy** creates a self-contained portable app bundle using APFS clones.

Controller support spans keyboard, mouse, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, MFi, and DirectInput gamepads such as 8BitDo devices. When running the North American v1.2 executable, **Settings > Controls** exposes **XtendedInput layout**, mapping `RT` and `LT` as independent analog throttle and brake triggers alongside full menu button prompts governed by `scripts/NFSU_XtendedInput.ini`. Steering wheels and online multiplayer remain unsupported.

## Isolated Mod Manager and Official Installation Steps

Release `v2.6` introduces a **Settings > Mods** tab that installs `.zip`, `.7z`, `.rar`, or folder mods covering both plain data replacements (`TRACKS`, `GLOBAL`, `CARS`) and Binary/Binarius installer scripts (`install.end`, `.endlauncher`) with their interactive setup prompts. For NA v1.2 installs, a dedicated **NFSU2 Unlimiter 4.0.0.802** entry runs statically lifted ASI logic so custom car and part mods load reliably. Changed files stay isolated inside `~/Library/Application Support/NFSU2/Mods`, leaving the source game directory intact and letting **Restore Original Game** revert cleanly at any point.

Because `NFSU2Recomp` targets Apple Silicon Macs exclusively (macOS 11 or later on M1+ hardware, while PC users continue running the original Windows game natively), players only need to download `NFSU2.zip` from GitHub Releases, move `NFSU2.app` into Applications, clear the Gatekeeper quarantine flag once, and point the launcher to their own game folder:

```bash
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/NFSU2.app
shasum -a 256 /path/to/SPEED2.EXE
```

Running `xattr` removes macOS quarantine before launching `NFSU2.app`, and `shasum -a 256` lets you confirm that your North American or European v1.2 `SPEED2.EXE` matches the supported hashes shown in the release notes.

zh.title: NFSU2Recomp 功能解析：苹果芯片原生极品飞车地下狂飙2
zh.excerpt: 全面介绍 NFSU2Recomp 在 Apple Silicon Mac 上的核心特性：Metal 原生与 HD 引擎、画面调校、SwiftUI 启动器及隔离 Mod 管理。
zh.body:
**NFSU2Recomp**（`TalhaMudo/NFSU2Recomp`）将 PC 版《极品飞车：地下狂飙 2》静态重编译为面向 Apple Silicon Mac 的原生 ARM64 Metal 应用。运行过程无需 Wine、CrossOver、虚拟机或实时 JIT 翻译：32 位 `SPEED2.EXE` 指令与 Direct3D 9 着色器在构建阶段即转译为原生 C 代码和 Metal Shading Language，启动后直接由苹果芯片原生执行。

![NFSU2Recomp 在 Apple Silicon Mac 上运行极品飞车地下狂飙 2 的夜间赛事实机画面](/news/assets/nfsu2-underground-2-gameplay-9db807bd.webp)

该项目并非仅让老游戏勉强启动，而是围绕玩家体验构建了完整的现代特性集，涵盖双图形引擎切换、宽屏投影修正、SwiftUI 存档管理器、模拟扳机手柄支持与无损隔离 Mod 系统。

## 原生 Metal 性能与低延迟音频调度

在底层，`tools/lifter/reloc2.py` 与 `tools/lifter/lift.py` 从 `SPEED2.EXE` 提取并提升了 `23,278` 个 x86-32 函数至原生 C，并对接手写的 `runtime/` 运行时层，分别接管 Metal 渲染、CoreAudio 音频与 macOS 输入事件。运行期间在栈上动态生成的短小 x86 thunk 由 `runtime/genexec.c` 直接解释执行，而开销较高的 D3DX9 效果路径则由 `runtime/d3dx_hle.c` 提供高层实现，避免拖慢主线程。

在 M1 Pro MacBook `1280x960` 分辨率实测中，比赛帧率稳定在 `119 fps`（受限于 120 Hz 显示刷新率），单帧 CPU 耗时约 `12.6 ms`；即便在 `3024x1964` 全视网膜 `120 fps` 下运行，标准引擎整机 CPU 与 GPU 合计功耗仅约 `6.5 W`，机身温度低于 `70` 摄氏度且风扇保持静音。CoreAudio 的两条 `10 ms` 定时器享有高优先级调度，加载赛道或通过调度中心切换桌面空间时不再断音，同时还修复了长时段游玩的内存增长问题，片头动画、带声效剧情过场、赛前场景与马力机测功图曲线均已正常呈现。

## Original 与 HD 双引擎、宽屏修复及画面选项

玩家可在应用主窗口一键选择保留经典 PC 观感的 **Original** 引擎，或切换至 **HD** 引擎启用 MSAA 抗锯齿（1440 线及以上为 `2x`，以下为 `4x`）、屏幕空间反射（SSR）与光线追踪反射特性（全视网膜分辨率功耗约 `18 W`）。

面向宽屏及 4K 显示器，Hor+ 宽屏投影结合 `NFSRES` 与 `HUDFIX` 修正了界面比例并消除了画面左右边缘物体延迟弹出；雨天暗角滤镜也已铺满整块宽屏区域。从 `v2.5` 起，HD 引擎新增 **Settings > Picture** 标签页，可减弱 PC 版偏色滤镜、启用主机版 Gamma、边缘平滑与画面锐化，并独立开关湿滑路面与后视镜里的天空反射、车灯照射反光与细节增强。日常快捷键 `Cmd-F` 可随时切换窗口与全屏模式，`Cmd+Shift+D` 支持保存画面帧诊断快照。

## SwiftUI 启动器、存档与 XtendedInput 手柄支持

内置 SwiftUI 启动器首次启动时仅需用户自行指向包含无光盘验证 v1.2 `SPEED2.EXE` 的游戏目录（兼容 `4,800,512` 字节美版与 `4,788,224` 字节欧版，程序本身不含游戏资产）。通过 **Saves** 菜单可直接新建生涯存档、保留备份或导入导出 ZIP 存档包；点击 **Make Copy** 则可利用 APFS 克隆打包出一份内含资产的便携式独立应用副本。

外设操控支持键盘、鼠标，以及 Xbox、PlayStation、Nintendo Switch、MFi 和八位堂等 DirectInput 手柄。针对美版 v1.2 可执行文件，**Settings > Controls** 提供 **XtendedInput layout** 开关，依照 `scripts/NFSU_XtendedInput.ini` 配置将 `RT`、`LT` 设为独立线性油门与刹车，并同步完善全菜单按键提示。目前方向盘外设与联机对战暂未支持。

## 隔离 Mod 管理器与官方安装步骤

自 `v2.6` 版本起，启动器集成 **Settings > Mods** 标签页，支持导入 `.zip`、`.7z`、`.rar` 或文件夹格式的 Mod，既可直接替换 `TRACKS`、`GLOBAL`、`CARS` 等资源文件，也兼容附带 `install.end` / `.endlauncher` 的 Binary 与 Binarius 交互式安装脚本。美版用户还可启用内置静态提升版的 **NFSU2 Unlimiter 4.0.0.802** 来加载扩展车辆与改装件包。所有修改均保存在 `~/Library/Application Support/NFSU2/Mods`，原始游戏文件夹保持零改动，通过 **Restore Original Game** 可随时还原。

由于该项目专门面向 Apple Silicon 芯片的 Mac（需 M1 及以上机型搭配 macOS 11 或更新系统，Windows 用户原本即可原生运行原版 PC 游戏），普通玩家无需自行编译源码：直接从 GitHub Releases 下载 `NFSU2.zip`，解压后把 `NFSU2.app` 拖入应用程序目录，再执行一次终端命令解除系统隔离并核对 `SPEED2.EXE` 校验值即可选择游戏目录开玩：

```bash
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/NFSU2.app
shasum -a 256 /path/to/SPEED2.EXE
```

第一条 `xattr` 命令用于在首次启动前移除 macOS Gatekeeper 隔离标记，而 `shasum -a 256` 则便于确认自己持有的美版或欧版 v1.2 `SPEED2.EXE` 文件哈希是否与发行说明一致。

items.title: ArtCraft (storytold): Suite 17 Aplikasi Kreatif dan Kantor Berbasis Rust
items.excerpt: Mengulas ekosistem open-source ArtCraft dari storytold, daftar 17 aplikasi Crafting Apps berbasis Rust, cara instalasi lintas OS, dan perintah build Cargo.
items.body:
Mengganti aplikasi kreatif dan perkantoran berbayar sering berakhir pada kompromi yang tidak nyaman: wrapper web berbasis Electron memakan banyak memori, sementara alternatif open-source lama menuntut pengguna mempelajari ulang kebiasaan kerja dari nol. Organisasi GitHub `storytold` lewat proyek ArtCraft (`getartcraft.com`) menempuh jalur berbeda dengan menulis ulang jajaran aplikasi kreatif dan produktivitas secara native memakai Rust.

![Identitas visual resmi ArtCraft beserta ikon aplikasi Crafting Apps](/news/assets/artcraft-open-source-tools-72b72d44.webp)

Di dalam repositori `storytold`, ArtCraft sebenarnya terbagi menjadi dua lini yang saling melengkapi: ArtCraft Studio untuk pembuatan gambar serta video AI, dan Crafting Apps yang menghimpun 17 aplikasi desktop independen di bawah pengelolaan ArtCraft Launcher.

## Dua Lini Produk: ArtCraft Studio dan 17 Crafting Apps

ArtCraft Studio (`storytold/artcraft`) berfungsi sebagai workspace penyusunan adegan 2D dan kanvas 3D sebelum dirender dengan model gambar maupun video AI. Pada halaman unduhan resminya, versi desktop `0.41.1` tersedia bersama versi peramban di `app.getartcraft.com`.

Berbeda dari studio AI tersebut, Crafting Apps berisi 17 aplikasi desktop native yang dibangun dari awal dengan Rust murni, toolkit antarmuka `egui`, dan lapisan grafis GPU `wgpu`. Seluruh aplikasi berjalan lokal secara offline tanpa Electron, memakai lisensi ganda permisif MIT atau Apache-2.0 untuk kode sumbernya, dan memodelkan setiap aksi penyuntingan sebagai perintah terstruktur agar bisa dijalankan lewat UI, CLI, kanal kontrol JSON, maupun server MCP. Kecuali FilmCraft yang masih berfokus di desktop, 16 aplikasi lainnya juga mendukung kompilasi ke WebAssembly agar berjalan di browser.

Cakupan 17 aplikasi resmi Crafting Apps dibagi ke tiga kelompok kerja utama:

- Aplikasi grafis, foto, dan dokumen terdiri atas PhotoCraft (editor raster dan berkas `.psd`), VectorCraft (ilustrasi vektor), LightCraft (pustaka foto dan pengolah RAW non-destruktif), DesignCraft (tata letak halaman dan penerbitan), FigCraft (desain antarmuka dan prototyping), serta PdfCraft (pembaca, pengatur, dan editor PDF).
- Aplikasi video, animasi, audio, dan 3D mencakup FilmCraft (editor video non-linear), EffectCraft (motion graphics dan compositing), AniCraft (animasi vektor 2D), SoundCraft (Digital Audio Workstation), TextureCraft (lukis tekstur 3D), serta MaterialCraft (perancang material prosedural berbasis node).
- Aplikasi perkantoran, teknik, dan utilitas meliputi WordCraft (pengolah dokumen `.docx` dengan ribbon, styles, dan track changes), GridCraft (spreadsheet dan analisis data), DeckCraft (presentasi slide), CADCraft (CAD 2D/3D), dan Craft Anything untuk mengeksplorasi cara kerja perangkat lunak lalu membangun aplikasi sendiri.

Di luar 17 aplikasi resmi tersebut, katalog ArtCraft Launcher turut menampilkan dua aplikasi komunitas: SolidCraft (CAD 3D parametrik dari Tangency Labs) dan MailCraft (email, kalender, serta kontak dari UCS Labs).

## Cara Install Resmi di Windows, macOS, Linux, dan Web

Menurut panduan resmi `storytold/craft-launcher`, pengguna tidak perlu mencari unduhan tiap aplikasi satu per satu. Cukup pasang **ArtCraft Launcher** sekali sesuai sistem operasi Anda; launcher otomatis mengenali jenis OS dan arsitektur CPU, mengunduh rilis resmi dari GitHub, memeriksa integritas file terhadap `SHA256SUMS.txt`, serta menangani pembaruan maupun koleksi font lewat Craft Font Manager.

Halaman Releases GitHub menyediakan installer siap pakai untuk seluruh sistem operasi desktop utama. Pada **Windows 10 dan 11**, tersedia installer `.msi` untuk `x64`, `arm64`, dan `x86` (termasuk pemasangan per-user pada `x64` tanpa hak administrator) atau paket portabel `.zip` yang cukup diekstrak lalu dijalankan lewat `artcraft-launcher.exe`. Pada **macOS 11 Big Sur ke atas**, tersedia berkas universal `.dmg` bertanda tangan resmi untuk Apple Silicon maupun Intel yang tinggal diseret ke folder `Applications`. Sementara di **Linux** (`x86_64`, `aarch64`, hingga `riscv64`), tersedia format `.AppImage`, `.deb`, `.rpm`, `.flatpak`, dan `.tar.gz`, serta edisi peramban di `app.getartcraft.com`.

## Perintah Instalasi Paket Linux dan Mulai Memasang Aplikasi

Setelah pengguna Windows menjalankan installer `.msi` (atau mengekstrak `.zip` portabel) dan pengguna macOS menyalin `.dmg` ke `Applications`, pengguna Linux dapat memasang paket rilis melalui manajer paket distro masing-masing atau memakai repositori Flatpak OCI resmi tanpa akses root:

```bash
# Debian / Ubuntu / Pop!_OS (dari rilis .deb yang diunduh)
sudo apt install ./artcraft-launcher-<ver>-linux-x86_64.deb

# Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE (dari rilis .rpm yang diunduh)
sudo dnf install ./artcraft-launcher-<ver>-linux-x86_64.rpm

# Semua distro Linux lewat remote Flatpak OCI resmi
flatpak remote-add --user --if-not-exists artcraft-oci https://getartcraft.com/artcraft-oci.flatpakrepo
flatpak install --user artcraft-oci ai.storyteller.artcraft-launcher
```

Ganti `<ver>` dengan nomor versi rilis yang Anda unduh (misalnya `0.1.0`) saat memasang berkas `.deb` atau `.rpm`. Begitu ArtCraft Launcher terbuka di Windows, macOS, maupun Linux, klik tombol Install pada aplikasi apa pun dari 17 Crafting Apps agar terpasang langsung ke direktori aplikasi standar sistem.

## Status Pengembangan dan Lisensi Merek

Sebagian besar komponen di Crafting Apps dan ArtCraft Launcher saat ini masih berada pada status *in development* atau *early alpha*, misalnya PhotoCraft, PdfCraft, AniCraft, FigCraft, dan Craft Anything. Meski kode sumber aplikasi bebas dimodifikasi dan didistribusikan di bawah lisensi MIT atau Apache-2.0, tim `storytold` memisahkan lisensi merek dagang untuk nama serta logo ArtCraft agar tidak dipakai ulang pada proyek fork tanpa izin.

en.title: ArtCraft (storytold): 17 Rust Native Creative and Office Apps
en.excerpt: Explore storytold ArtCraft and its 17 open-source Crafting Apps in native Rust, plus official launcher installation across Windows, macOS, Linux, and the web.
en.body:
Replacing commercial creative and office software often forces an awkward compromise: Electron wrappers eat memory on basic tasks, while older open-source tools require relearning years of muscle memory. The GitHub organization `storytold` takes another path with ArtCraft (`getartcraft.com`), rebuilding creative and productivity suites natively in Rust.

![Official ArtCraft branding alongside icons of the Crafting Apps suite](/news/assets/artcraft-open-source-tools-72b72d44.webp)

Within `storytold`, ArtCraft splits cleanly into two complementary tracks: ArtCraft Studio for AI image and video creation, and Crafting Apps, an umbrella of 17 standalone native desktop applications managed by ArtCraft Launcher.

## Two Lines: ArtCraft Studio and 17 Crafting Apps

ArtCraft Studio (`storytold/artcraft`) gives artists a 2D composition workspace and 3D canvas for staging scenes before rendering with AI image or video models. Its official downloads page currently lists desktop release `0.41.1` alongside a browser edition at `app.getartcraft.com`.

Separate from the AI studio, Crafting Apps spans 17 native applications written from scratch in pure Rust using the `egui` toolkit and `wgpu` GPU abstraction. All 17 run offline locally with no Electron runtime, release their source code under dual permissive MIT or Apache-2.0 terms, and represent every edit as a structured command runnable from the GUI, CLI, JSON control channel, or MCP server. Sixteen of the tools also target WebAssembly for browser execution, with FilmCraft staying focused on desktop editing.

The 17 official Crafting Apps divide naturally across three creative workflows:

- Graphics, photo, and document publishing cover PhotoCraft (raster editing and `.psd` support), VectorCraft (vector illustration), LightCraft (photo library and non-destructive RAW processor), DesignCraft (page layout and publishing), FigCraft (interface design and prototyping), and PdfCraft (PDF reading, organization, and editing).
- Video, animation, audio, and 3D work bring FilmCraft (non-linear video editor), EffectCraft (motion graphics and compositing), AniCraft (2D vector animation), SoundCraft (Digital Audio Workstation), TextureCraft (3D texture painting), and MaterialCraft (node-based procedural material authoring).
- Office, engineering, and utility software span WordCraft (a `.docx` word processor with ribbon, styles, and track changes), GridCraft (spreadsheets and data analysis), DeckCraft (slide decks), CADCraft (2D/3D CAD), and Craft Anything for inspecting how software works and assembling custom apps.

Beyond the core 17, the ArtCraft Launcher catalog also indexes two community-maintained apps: SolidCraft (parametric 3D CAD by Tangency Labs) and MailCraft (email, calendar, and contacts by UCS Labs).

## Official Multi-OS Installation Across Windows, macOS, and Linux

Following the official `storytold/craft-launcher` guide, users do not need to hunt down dozens of separate downloads. Installing **ArtCraft Launcher** once automatically detects your OS and CPU architecture, downloads signed release builds from GitHub, verifies every package against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and installs updates or typefaces through Craft Font Manager.

Official installers on the [GitHub Releases page](https://github.com/storytold/craft-launcher/releases/latest) support every major desktop platform out of the box:

- Windows 10 and 11 offer `.msi` installers for `x64`, `arm64`, and `x86` (including per-user `x64` installs without administrator elevation) as well as zero-install portable `.zip` archives containing `artcraft-launcher.exe`.
- macOS 11 Big Sur or newer uses a single signed, notarized `macos-universal.dmg` for both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs; open the disk image and drag ArtCraft Launcher into Applications.
- Linux (`x86_64`, `aarch64`, and `riscv64`) ships `.deb`, `.rpm`, portable `.AppImage`, `.flatpak`, and `.tar.gz` bundles, backed by signed package feeds at `getartcraft.com/linux`, alongside FreeBSD 14 tarballs and browser catalog previews at `app.getartcraft.com`.

## Official Linux Package & Web Launcher Setup

While Windows users run the `.msi` installer (or `.zip`) and macOS users drag the `.dmg` into Applications, Linux desktop users can install the downloaded package directly via their distro package manager or register the official Flatpak OCI repository without root access:

```bash
# Debian / Ubuntu / Pop!_OS (from downloaded release .deb)
sudo apt install ./artcraft-launcher-<ver>-linux-x86_64.deb

# Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE (from downloaded release .rpm)
sudo dnf install ./artcraft-launcher-<ver>-linux-x86_64.rpm

# Any Linux distro via official user-level Flatpak OCI repository
flatpak remote-add --user --if-not-exists artcraft-oci https://getartcraft.com/artcraft-oci.flatpakrepo
flatpak install --user artcraft-oci ai.storyteller.artcraft-launcher
```

Substitute `<ver>` with the release version number you downloaded (such as `0.1.0`) when installing `.deb` or `.rpm` packages locally. Once ArtCraft Launcher opens on Windows, macOS, or Linux, click Install beside any of the 17 Crafting Apps and the launcher places native packages cleanly into each OS's standard application folder.

## Development Status and Brand Boundaries

Most applications in Crafting Apps and ArtCraft Launcher are still actively maturing in *in development* or *early alpha* stages, including PhotoCraft, PdfCraft, AniCraft, FigCraft, and Craft Anything. While the application codebases allow modification and redistribution under MIT or Apache-2.0 licenses, `storytold` keeps ArtCraft trademark rights separate so forks cannot reuse the official name or logos without permission.

zh.title: ArtCraft（storytold）：基于 Rust 的 17 款开源创意与办公套件
zh.excerpt: 全面解析 storytold 开源项目 ArtCraft：17 款纯 Rust 原生 Crafting Apps 及 Windows、macOS、Linux 官方启动器安装教程。
zh.body:
替换传统付费创意与办公软件往往面临两难：基于 Electron 的桌面套壳工具内存占用过高，而传统开源替代品又常要求用户重塑长期操作习惯。GitHub 组织 `storytold` 通过 ArtCraft 项目（`getartcraft.com`）选择用 Rust 从零重写一套原生创作与办公应用生态。

![ArtCraft 官方品牌标识与 Crafting Apps 应用图标展示](/news/assets/artcraft-open-source-tools-72b72d44.webp)

在 `storytold` 仓库体系下，ArtCraft 清晰拆分为两条互补产品线：用于 AI 图像与视频场景编排的 ArtCraft Studio，以及由 ArtCraft Launcher 统一管理、包含 17 款独立原生桌面软件的 Crafting Apps。

## 两大产品线：ArtCraft Studio 与 17 款 Crafting Apps

ArtCraft Studio（`storytold/artcraft`）聚焦 2D 场景组合与 3D 画布调度，方便创作者在提交给 AI 图像或视频模型渲染前先完成空间构图。官网下载页目前提供桌面端 `0.41.1` 版本，同时开放浏览器版本 `app.getartcraft.com`。

与 AI 工作室独立并行的 Crafting Apps 汇集了 17 款纯 Rust 原生应用，界面基于 `egui` 构建，图形管线由 `wgpu` 驱动。整套软件无需 Electron、可完全离线在本地运行，源码采用 MIT 与 Apache-2.0 双重宽松许可，并将每项编辑操作建模为结构化命令，可直接经由界面、CLI、JSON 控制通道或 MCP 服务器调用。除专注桌面剪辑的 FilmCraft 外，其余 16 款均支持编译为 WebAssembly 在浏览器中运行。

这 17 款官方应用覆盖三类日常工作流：

- 图形图像处理与文档出版包含 PhotoCraft（位图修图与 `.psd` 支持）、VectorCraft（矢量插画）、LightCraft（照片管理与无损 RAW 冲洗）、DesignCraft（版面排版）、FigCraft（界面设计与原型制作）以及 PdfCraft（PDF 阅读、整理与编辑）。
- 视频动画与音频 3D 工具包含 FilmCraft（非线性视频剪辑）、EffectCraft（动态图形与合成）、AniCraft（二维矢量动画）、SoundCraft（数字音频工作站）、TextureCraft（3D 纹理绘制）与 MaterialCraft（基于节点的程序化材质设计）。
- 办公工程与通用组件涵盖 WordCraft（支持功能区、样式与修订跟踪的 `.docx` 文字处理工具）、GridCraft（电子表格与数据分析）、DeckCraft（幻灯片演示）、CADCraft（二维/三维 CAD）以及帮助开发者拆解软件机制并组装自定义应用的 Craft Anything。

此外，ArtCraft Launcher 目录还收录了两款社区应用：Tangency Labs 开发的 SolidCraft（参数化 3D CAD）与 UCS Labs 开发的 MailCraft（邮件、日历与联系人工具）。

## 跨平台官方安装方案（Windows、macOS 与 Linux）

按照官方 `storytold/craft-launcher` 仓库说明，普通用户无需四处翻找单独包体，只需从 GitHub Releases 下载并安装一次 **ArtCraft Launcher**。启动器会自动识别当前操作系统与 CPU 架构，对照官方 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 校验下载完整性，并一键管理后续应用更新及 Craft Font Manager 字体库。

目前官方发布页面向各主流平台提供了完整成品安装包：Windows 10/11 提供兼容 `x64`、`arm64` 与 `x86` 架构的 `.msi` 安装程序（其中 `x64` 支持当前用户免管理员权限安装）以及解压即用的便携版 `.zip`（内含 `artcraft-launcher.exe`）；macOS 11 Big Sur 及以上系统直接下载经过公证签名的通用镜像 `macos-universal.dmg`，同时支持 Apple Silicon 与 Intel Mac，拖入应用程序目录即可；Linux 与 FreeBSD 14 则提供 `.deb`、`.rpm`、`.AppImage`、`.flatpak` 与 `.tar.gz`，亦可通过浏览器直接预览 Web 目录。

## Linux 官方包管理命令与启动器使用

在 Windows 双击 `.msi`（或解压 `.zip` 运行）以及在 macOS 通过 `.dmg` 拖放安装后，Linux 用户也可以根据自己所用的发行版，在终端执行对应的官方安装包或用户级 Flatpak 源命令：

```bash
# Debian / Ubuntu / Pop!_OS 安装官方 .deb 包
sudo apt install ./artcraft-launcher-<ver>-linux-x86_64.deb

# Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE 安装官方 .rpm 包
sudo dnf install ./artcraft-launcher-<ver>-linux-x86_64.rpm

# 通用 Linux 发行版通过官方用户级 Flatpak OCI 源安装
flatpak remote-add --user --if-not-exists artcraft-oci https://getartcraft.com/artcraft-oci.flatpakrepo
flatpak install --user artcraft-oci ai.storyteller.artcraft-launcher
```

将上述命令中的 `<ver>` 替换为从发布页下载的实际版本号（例如 `0.1.0`）即可完成安装。无论是在 Windows、macOS 还是 Linux 上打开 ArtCraft Launcher，只需在窗口中挑选任意应用并点击 Install，启动器便会将其妥善安装到对应系统的标准应用目录中。

## 当前开发阶段与商标说明

目前 Crafting Apps 与 ArtCraft Launcher 中大多数组件仍处于早期开发阶段（*in development* 或 *early alpha*），例如 PhotoCraft、PdfCraft、AniCraft、FigCraft 与 Craft Anything。虽然代码仓库以开源许可证形式允许自由修改和再分发，但 `storytold` 单独保留 ArtCraft 名称及品牌标识的商标权，未经许可不得将其直接沿用到衍生分支产品中。
